_comment: AI personality copy for the Huddlepuffers redesign. Regenerate EVERY weekly refresh from that week's numbers (friendly buddy-league tone). Keyed by owner_name. build_redesign.py merges these into the data object. See HANDOFF.md section 4.
state_of_league: The top four are a knife fight: colsheske leads on points, chochstedler and Nmhochstedler hoard the richest rosters, and isaacimel keeps winning anyway at 12-2. The middle — aigo100 and thedukestill — will decide their season at the deadline. Down low, Forshey11 and Swerve33 are racing for rookie picks more than wins.

colsheske.blurb: League-best 2,857 points and a top-three dynasty roster — the clear team to beat.

chochstedler.blurb: Owns the league's deepest dynasty haul and a 10-4 record to match — built to last.

isaacimel.blurb: League-best 12-2 record; the roster value lags the wins, but a banner counts the same.

Nmhochstedler.blurb: Second-richest roster in the league — the 9-5 record undersells what this team can do.

aigo100.blurb: An 8-6 tweener with a middling war chest — one bold trade from contention or the lottery.

thedukestill.blurb: Perfectly 7-7 with a roster to match — the league's most genuinely average team.

SpeedwayJesus.blurb: At 5-9 with a lighter roster, the rebuild is on — swap veterans for youth and picks.

mmmatlock.blurb: A 4-10 season and the league's thinnest scoring — a prime seller; the phone should be ringing.

Forshey11.blurb: Rock-bottom at 2-12 with the lightest roster — but a full teardown means premium picks incoming.

Swerve33.blurb: Anchoring the power index at 2-12 — the good news is the only way left is up.
